source:
@@U00931@@
(To the MONKEYS.)

@@U00932@@
Tell me, you accursed creatures, what are you stirring in that stew?

@@U00934@@
Watery soup for beggars.

@@U00936@@
It’s sure to go over well. (The MALE MONKEY comes over and fawns on

@@U00938@@
)

@@U00940@@
Throw the dice, sir, And so be nice, sir; Things are vile, So win me a pile. To be rich in pence Is to have sense.

@@U00942@@
How lucky this monkey would think himself if only he could play the lottery. (Meanwhile the YOUNG MONKEYS have been playing with a large ball, which now they roll forward.)

@@U00944@@
This is the world, Forever twirled Round and about. It rings like glass, And is, alas, Hollow, no doubt, And so it will shatter, And will little matter In the round and about.
translation:
@@U00931@@
（对猴子们来说。）

@@U00932@@
告诉我，你们这些该死的生物，你们在炖菜里搅拌什么？

@@U00934@@
给乞丐喝的稀汤。

@@U00936@@
一定会顺利进行的。 （公猴走过来阿谀奉承

@@U00938@@
）

@@U00940@@
掷骰子，先生，所以要友善，先生；事情很卑鄙，所以赢我一堆。富有便士就是有理智。

@@U00942@@
如果这只猴子能玩彩票的话，他会觉得自己多么幸运。 （与此同时，小猴子们一直在玩一个大球，现在它们向前滚动。）

@@U00944@@
这就是世界，永远旋转着。它像玻璃一样响亮，而且，唉，毫无疑问是空心的，所以它会破碎，并且在圆形和周围都没有什么影响。
